---
title: "Week 08 Interactive Demo"
format: html
---

Source note: learner-facing demo is authored directly in `interactive_demo.html` to support bilingual UI, no-JS fallback, responsive HTML bars, and GitHub Pages-safe interaction without a build step.

The demo lets learners:

- choose an error category;
- adjust frequency and severity;
- inspect a teaching priority score;
- read a generated Results/teaching sentence;
- keep transfer claims cautious.
